$schema_comment: Grok Build hooks. Canonical guardrail logic lives in .claude/hooks/ and brain/hooks/; bin/run-claude-hook.sh only adapts payload and verdict shapes - never fork hook logic into a Grok-only copy. WINDOWS: a bare `bash` is WSL's or nothing. Set GROK_SHELL=bash in your environment so Grok runs these commands under Git Bash, with no edit to this file; the Windows section of docs/harness-support.md has the detail. If your harness does not run hooks from the project root, make the script path absolute too. The sensitive-file check sets failClosed: Grok lets a tool call through when a hook cannot run, and a check that cannot start should refuse the edit instead - so on a Windows machine with no WSL, settle `bash` before your first edit or every edit is refused. No UserPromptSubmit hook is wired: Grok discards an allowing prompt hook's output (CLI 1.0.77), so brain/ context cannot be injected here - ask the agent to search the brain.
